items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I think Joe was riding with him. Mario Perry.

ctx.x: at all, and I guess maybe he was trying to spare my feelings. He said, 'that stinks. That's lousy,' and he said, 'I am going to get it recalled.' You know, he went up to the Columbia office and tried to get them to bring that back if anything is possible to -- you know, not to put it out. And to recall it.

He made a big fuss over it for awhile. I could see his point to a certain extent. Andy has done better choruses, but it's just the way things happened, so it was left in but at that time the band come back and the boys had all been out there and they told me what a wonderful time they had. And the -- but one of the guys got killed. I think Joe was riding with him. Mario Perry. They all had cars, they all had houses and they all got paid, all the time they didn't make the picture.

And you know, all I could hear was, 'You should have been along.' We met so and so and they all had young starlets and things. They must have had a real ball. But the band came back and then they went out again later on to make the picture. When something was straightened out, the book was straightened out and a couple of things, and at that time Paul said, 'You better come out with us this time,' and I said, 'I got a car here and I got an apartment here and I don't know what to do with all that.'
